summary: Compose mirror-constrained ion moments, a Boltzmann electron response and a bounded potential bisection; evaluate both states again at the converged potential and assemble total parallel and perpendicular pressures.

identity.relation: Positive-ion mirror kinetic moments and Boltzmann electrons closed by local quasineutral potential
identity.direction: (magnetic field, flux label, ion and electron reference states, optional plug profiles, solver controls) -> quasineutral potential, terminal moments and total pressures
identity.definition: For each active sample, the graph solves the potential at which log(Z_i*n_i(phi))-log(n_e(phi)) is zero, where Z_i=charge_c/e, n_i comes from the mirror-constrained bi-Maxwellian moment operator and n_e from the Boltzmann electron operator. Positive ion and electron reference densities make a sample active; both zero make it inactive and preserve the ion reference potential. The potential solver uses bounded bracket expansion and at most max_iterations bisection steps. After success the graph reevaluates ion and electron states at the returned potential and adds electron pressure equally to ion parallel and perpendicular pressures.
identity.model: One positive-ion invariant bi-Maxwellian with optional two-plug loss-cone reduction, paired with prescribed-temperature Boltzmann electrons. Charge neutrality is solved locally through the explicit logarithmic residual, not an equilibrium field solve.
identity.geometry: Local mirror magnetic-field magnitudes and optional left/right plug fields; no field-line geometry, spatial metric or flux-surface reconstruction is computed.
identity.coordinates: b_t is scalar or exactly psi-shaped; other field/profile values are scalar, exactly psi-shaped or caller callables of the current psi array. The historical psi label is Wb, but the callable does not check flux normalization, coordinate alignment or a [Z,R] axis order.
identity.boundary: Both plug fields are supplied together for the loss-cone branch; absent plugs or refill equal to one bypass it. The ion/electron reference densities must be simultaneously positive or simultaneously zero at each sample. Bisection brackets must contain the root after the solver's finite expansion budget.
assumptions: The caller's ion and electron reference states, magnetic-field and flux-label fields describe the same samples and share a consistent flux convention.
The composed logarithmic charge residual is finite and has the positive-lower, negative-upper orientation expected by the bisection operator over the selected brackets.
The mirror kinetic and Boltzmann electron models are appropriate to the requested plasma state; running the graph does not establish their physical applicability.

inputs.name: b_t
inputs.description: Local mirror magnetic-field magnitude.
inputs.dtype: real array-like converted to float64
inputs.constraints: Must be finite and strictly positive when evaluated by the ion-moment operator.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Caller flux-profile label and output-shape carrier.
inputs.shape: scalar or array; defines the graph sample shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like converted to float64
inputs.constraints: Finite; no axis, range or Wb-versus-Wb/rad convention check.

inputs.name: mass_kg
inputs.description: Positive-ion mass passed to the mirror moment operator.
inputs.dtype: float-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; validated but does not enter the current moment formulas.

inputs.name: charge_c
inputs.description: Positive ion charge; also converted to charge state Z_i = charge_c/e.
inputs.dtype: float-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive, with a finite positive derived charge state.

inputs.name: density_ref_m3
inputs.description: Ion reference number density.
inputs.shape: scalar, exactly psi-shaped array or callable(psi) returning either
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated field finite and nonnegative; must be positive exactly where the selected electron reference density is positive.

inputs.name: temperature_parallel_j
inputs.description: Ion parallel reference thermal energy and ion bracket scale.
inputs.shape: scalar, exactly psi-shaped array or callable(psi) returning either
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated field finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: temperature_perpendicular_ref_j
inputs.description: Ion perpendicular reference thermal energy.
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated by the moment operator; finite, strictly positive, and yielding a positive integrability coefficient.

inputs.name: b_ref_t
inputs.description: Ion reference magnetic-field magnitude.
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated by the moment operator; finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: electron_temperature_j
inputs.description: Prescribed Boltzmann electron thermal energy and electron bracket scale.
inputs.shape: scalar, exactly psi-shaped array or callable(psi) returning either
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated field finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: phi_ref_v
inputs.description: Ion reference potential, also returned where both reference densities are zero.
inputs.shape: scalar, exactly psi-shaped array or callable(psi) returning either
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated field finite.

inputs.name: b_plug_left_t
inputs.description: Left mirror-plug field for optional loss-cone moments.
inputs.shape: None, scalar, psi-compatible array or callable(psi)
inputs.dtype: null, real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Supply with b_plug_right_t; evaluated for finite positive values when plug integration is active.

inputs.name: b_plug_right_t
inputs.description: Right mirror-plug field for optional loss-cone moments.
inputs.shape: None, scalar, psi-compatible array or callable(psi)
inputs.dtype: null, real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Supply with b_plug_left_t; evaluated for finite positive values when plug integration is active.

inputs.name: phi_plug_left_v
inputs.description: Left plug electrostatic potential.
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated for finiteness only in the active plug branch.

inputs.name: phi_plug_right_v
inputs.description: Right plug electrostatic potential.
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated for finiteness only in the active plug branch.

inputs.name: loss_cone_refill
inputs.description: Fraction restoring full bi-Maxwellian pitch occupation.
inputs.dtype: float-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Finite within [0,1]; one bypasses plug integration.

inputs.name: quadrature_order
inputs.description: Legendre order for active plug pitch integration.
inputs.dtype: float- and int-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Finite with int(value) at least 8; exact integer value is not enforced by the moment operator.

inputs.name: electron_density_ref_m3
inputs.description: Optional electron reference density; None derives Z_i times ion reference density.
inputs.shape: None, scalar, exactly psi-shaped array or callable(psi) returning either
inputs.dtype: null, real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: If supplied, evaluated field finite and nonnegative and has the same zero/nonzero mask as ion reference density.

inputs.name: electron_phi_ref_v
inputs.description: Optional Boltzmann electron reference potential; omission uses ion phi_ref_v.
inputs.shape: scalar, exactly psi-shaped array or callable(psi) returning either
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: If explicitly supplied, the field must be finite; explicit None is invalid, while the document's null default represents omission.

inputs.name: potential_tolerance_v
inputs.description: Maximum active bisection bracket width.
inputs.dtype: finite float-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

inputs.name: quasineutral_tolerance
inputs.description: Maximum active absolute logarithmic charge residual.
inputs.dtype: finite float-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Maximum number of bisection midpoint evaluations.
inputs.dtype: Python or NumPy integer, excluding bool
inputs.constraints: The graph checks integer >= 1; the bound potential operator requires >= 2, which is the effective public contract.

inputs.name: initial_bracket_thermal
inputs.description: Initial potential bracket half-width as a multiple of combined ion and electron thermal voltage.
inputs.dtype: finite float-convertible scalar
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Final ion parallel pressure plus isotropic electron pressure.
outputs.constraints: From terminal pressure assembly; addition has no separate finite-output check.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Final ion perpendicular pressure plus isotropic electron pressure.
outputs.constraints: From terminal pressure assembly; addition has no separate finite-output check.

outputs.name: ion_density
outputs.description: Mirror-constrained ion number density at the returned potential.
outputs.constraints: Passed through from the final ion moment mapping.

outputs.name: electron_density
outputs.description: Boltzmann electron number density at the returned potential.
outputs.constraints: Passed through from the final electron state.

outputs.name: electrostatic_potential
outputs.description: Converged potential on active samples and reference potential on zero-density samples.
outputs.constraints: Overwrites the pressure assembler's absent-potential placeholder with the solver result.

outputs.name: relative_charge_residual
outputs.description: Final (Z_i*n_i-n_e)/max(Z_i*n_i+n_e,tiny) from the Boltzmann response.
outputs.constraints: Not the logarithmic residual used for bisection; zero-density or clipped extremes require care in physical interpretation.

outputs.name: kinetic_moments
outputs.description: Complete final mirror ion-moment mapping including density, pressures, local temperatures and pitch integrals.
outputs.constraints: Refers to the final ion mapping; field meanings and units follow the mirror-constrained-moments contract.

outputs.name: ion_p_parallel
outputs.description: Final ion parallel pressure component before electron pressure is added.
outputs.constraints: Converted and broadcast by terminal pressure assembly.

outputs.name: ion_p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Final ion perpendicular pressure component before electron pressure is added.
outputs.constraints: Converted and broadcast by terminal pressure assembly.

outputs.name: electron_pressure
outputs.description: Boltzmann electron pressure added to each ion pressure component.
outputs.constraints: Converted and broadcast by terminal pressure assembly.

outputs.name: density_m3
outputs.description: Final ion density retained as the original ion-moment field, alongside ion_density.
outputs.constraints: Copied from the final ion-moment mapping without extra validation by the assembler.

outputs.name: p_parallel_pa
outputs.description: Final ion parallel pressure retained under its original moment-field name.
outputs.constraints: Copied from the final ion-moment mapping; not the total p_parallel.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular_pa
outputs.description: Final ion perpendicular pressure retained under its original moment-field name.
outputs.constraints: Copied from the final ion-moment mapping; not the total p_perpendicular.

outputs.name: temperature_parallel_j
outputs.description: Evaluated ion parallel thermal-energy parameter retained from final moments.
outputs.constraints: Not reconstructed as depleted parallel pressure divided by depleted density.

outputs.name: temperature_perpendicular_local_j
outputs.description: Untruncated local perpendicular thermal-energy parameter retained from final moments.
outputs.constraints: Follows the bound mirror moment relation B/C.

outputs.name: untruncated_density_m3
outputs.description: Final ion density before plug pitch reduction.
outputs.constraints: Retained from final ion moments; includes the clipped potential exponent.

outputs.name: density_pitch_integral
outputs.description: Final dimensionless ion density pitch factor.
outputs.constraints: One when plug integration is bypassed.

outputs.name: parallel_pitch_integral
outputs.description: Final dimensionless ion parallel-pressure pitch factor.
outputs.constraints: One when plug integration is bypassed.

outputs.name: perpendicular_pitch_integral
outputs.description: Final dimensionless ion perpendicular-pressure pitch factor.
outputs.constraints: One when plug integration is bypassed.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Shared vectorized potential-bisection iteration count.
outputs.constraints: Zero if all samples are inactive; not a per-sample count.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether the potential solver completed successfully.
outputs.constraints: True on successful return; bracket or convergence failures raise instead of returning False.

preconditions: One positive-ion species and compatible ion/electron reference profiles are supplied on the same caller-owned psi samples.
Ion and electron reference densities are both positive or both zero at each sample, and the selected root is bracketable under the potential-solver sign convention.
The mirror moment integrability coefficient is positive; if a plug branch is active, both plug fields and valid pitch-integration parameters are supplied.
supported: Local quasineutral potential and gyrotropic total pressures for the declared mirror bi-Maxwellian and Boltzmann electron model.
Optional two-plug loss-cone moments, caller-supplied profile(psi) values, and inactive zero-density samples retaining phi_ref_v.
excluded: Multi-ion charge sums, non-Boltzmann electron responses, global equilibrium or electric-field reconstruction.
Inferring flux normalization, [Z,R] axis order, field-line geometry or compatibility with functions using a Wb/rad poloidal-flux convention.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Missing required graph inputs, incompatible b_t/psi or evaluated profile shapes, invalid positive-ion/thermal inputs, mismatched zero/nonzero reference-density masks, unpaired plug fields or invalid dependency inputs raise ValueError or a propagated numeric-conversion error. max_iterations=1 passes the graph's preliminary integer check but is rejected by the potential operator, which requires at least 2.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: An ion-moment, electron-response, reference-density or pressure-assembly exception propagates. The potential operator raises RuntimeError if a root cannot be bracketed after bounded expansion; no alternate model or root finder is selected.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: If all active surfaces do not satisfy both potential-width and logarithmic-residual tolerances within max_iterations, the potential operator raises RuntimeError and this TaskGraph returns no state.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result mapping is returned after a validation, dependency, bracketing or nonconvergence failure; intermediate trial moments are local to the call.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel-maintained mirror quasineutral TaskGraph corresponding to a saved Pleiades L1 composition description and maintained graph regressions. Historical source and admission labels are development provenance, not current SciRel expert recognition.
source_kinds: saved L1 TaskGraph description and graph contract

example.description: Solve a three-sample no-plug mirror state against Boltzmann electrons.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.closures import solve_mirror_quasineutral_closure
e = 1.602176634e-19
r = solve_mirror_quasineutral_closure(b_t=np.array([1.0, 1.4, 2.0]), psi=np.zeros(3), mass_kg=1.67262192595e-27, charge_c=e, density_ref_m3=2e18, temperature_parallel_j=1200*e, temperature_perpendicular_ref_j=2400*e, b_ref_t=1.0, electron_temperature_j=600*e)
b = np.array([1.0, 1.4, 2.0])
t_perp = b / ((b-1.0)/(1200*e) + 1.0/(2400*e))
expected = np.log(t_perp/(2400*e)) / (e/(1200*e) + e/(600*e))
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['electrostatic_potential'], expected, atol=2e-8)
assert np.max(np.abs(r['relative_charge_residual'])) < 1e-10
assert r['p_parallel'].shape == (3,) and r['converged']
example.expected: A three-sample potential matching the no-plug analytic limit within 2e-8 V, relative charge residual below 1e-10 and psi-shaped total pressure.

scope: No-plug analytic potential and quasineutral residual, plug loss-cone behavior, zero-density reference-potential fallback and caller profile(psi) evaluation.
Propagation of invalid and fractional potential iteration budgets through the graph.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct graph regressions establish selected no-plug and loss-cone results, a zero-density fallback, one callable psi profile and two invalid iteration controls. They do not establish all profile shapes, unique roots, model validity for arbitrary plasmas, a flux normalization convention, or current expert recognition. The historical total-pressure descriptor implies stronger density and residual validation than the maintained assembler performs; this graph document describes the latter.
known_limitations: The historical psi unit label is Wb while other SciRel poloidal-flux functions can use Wb/rad; the graph performs no conversion or convention validation.

The total-pressure assembler checks three pressure inputs but passes density and relative residual through without an independent finite or shape check; the graph obtains them from its bound ion and electron operators. The assembler can retain a supplied electron-state potential, but this graph passes no such field and then sets electrostatic_potential from the solver.
Numerical clipping and quadrature limits in the bound ion and electron operators carry into the closure; extremely large finite inputs may yield nonfinite derived fields or propagated failure.
Only one positive-ion species and a Boltzmann electron response are represented.
Public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.

Validate positive ion charge state Z_i = charge_c/e using _charge_state.
Compute the default electron reference density Z_i*n_i_ref; runtime asset_loader names this operator with an underscored identity.
Choose supplied or computed electron reference density, choose the electron reference potential, validate density masks, and form the active mask.
Collect declared ion-moment keyword inputs; replace only the raw parallel-temperature profile with its evaluated field and retain the original optional ion reference-potential value when supplied.
Expand moment_inputs and evaluate the mirror ion mapping at each trial potential and once more at the final potential.
Evaluate the Boltzmann electron mapping at trial and final potential; expose its logarithmic residual for the solver.
Bind the ion/electron evaluator as residual callback and run bounded bracket expansion and vectorized bisection.
Assemble final ion/electron mappings and add electron pressure to both ion pressure components.
Expose all terminal pressure-state and retained ion-moment fields; overwrite its potential placeholder with the solver potential, iterations and converged flag.

execution.ordering: Validate graph inputs; prepare same-shape fields, charge state and reference-density selection; bind the kinetic/electron residual callback; let the potential operator bracket and bisect; then reevaluate both states at its returned potential, assemble pressures and attach potential, iterations and convergence flag.
branches: When electron_density_ref_m3 is absent or None, call the reference-density operator; otherwise use the evaluated caller override without calling it.
When electron_phi_ref_v is omitted, use phi_ref_v; otherwise evaluate the supplied value (explicit None is invalid).
Both reference densities positive: solve locally; both zero: retain phi_ref_v while evaluating a final state.
Both plug fields absent or loss_cone_refill=1: bypass loss-cone integration; otherwise evaluate the two-plug pitch integrals.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns local normalized fields, active mask, callback and intermediate mappings. The potential operator owns trial brackets and midpoint state; the caller owns inputs and any profile(psi) callable. No state persists between calls.
execution.failure_propagation: Input or dependency failure, unbracketed root or exhausted potential iteration budget aborts the call without a partial result or fallback.

feedback.state: Active-sample lower/upper potential brackets and their logarithmic residuals, plus the current full-shape trial potential; inactive samples stay at phi_ref_v.
feedback.initialization: Use phi_ref_v +/- initial_bracket_thermal*(T_parallel/charge_c + T_e/e) on active samples; evaluate the composed ion/electron residual at both endpoints, expanding at most eight rounds when signs do not bracket a root.
feedback.update_order: For each midpoint, evaluate mirror ion density at trial potential, evaluate Boltzmann electron state at that potential and density, return logarithmic_charge_residual to the potential solver, test both tolerances, then replace the signed bracket endpoint if continuing.
feedback.continue_when: Any active bracket width exceeds potential_tolerance_v or any active absolute logarithmic residual exceeds quasineutral_tolerance, while the validated iteration budget remains.
feedback.stop_when: All active bracket widths are at most potential_tolerance_v and all active midpoint absolute logarithmic residuals are at most quasineutral_tolerance; no active samples return immediately with zero bisection iterations.
feedback.iteration_bound: At most max_iterations midpoint evaluations, default 100 and effectively required to be an integer >= 2; bracket expansion has at most eight rounds after initial endpoint evaluation.
feedback.nonconvergence: Raise RuntimeError for an unbracketed root or for exhausted midpoint iterations; return no partial terminal state.
